product.deliverable: After analyzing the Jumpy repository and autonomous state, the immediate priority is to validate core gameplay loops and settings persistence through automated journeys. The project has a functional one-touch loop with procedural level generation, persistence, and basic UI. Key risks include unverified moment-to-moment feel on devices and incomplete accessibility toggles. Acceptance criteria focus on: 1) Core retry loop functioning without crashes, 2) Settings UI reflecting persisted preferences, 3) Daily mode determinism. Scope limited to headless-validation-friendly interactions (taps, visibility checks) requiring no external dependencies. Blockers: real-device feel validation cannot be automated in CI; settings persistence depends on save/load which requires file system access (already tested in prior cycles).
